entities.summary: Wenceslao Carrillo Alonso-Forjador was a prominent Spanish Socialist leader and the father of Santiago Carrillo. He belonged to the "Caballerist" faction of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party and participated in the Casado's coup of March 1939.
